title: 4/28-30 blend_training and bluesky_post health checks paged before their natural deadlines (no time-of-day guard)
tier_reason: false-positive health alerts in the first days of the health subpackage; no delivery, state or liveness impact

contract.text: blend_training alerts only when tomorrow's blend is missing after its 3 AM cron should have produced it, and bluesky_post alerts only when a locked pick is still unposted after posting should have happened.
contract.source: commit f0c3af9 message body; src/bts/health/post_failure.py module docstring ('Run at end-of-day, well after first-pitch lock')

mechanism.text: both checks evaluated their condition whenever the health runner ran, with no time-of-day guard: blend_training flagged the next day's blend before the 3:06 AM cron creates it, and bluesky_post flagged a pick not yet posted before its lineup-confirmation or fallback posting time

watchdog.trigger: a delivery check evaluated only at its natural deadline: at the earliest pick game's first pitch minus 5 min, a committed pick with no delivery record (not before)
watchdog.recovery_assertion: no post-failure page on days whose pick was delivered before its cutoff

evidence.what: both alerts had no time-of-day guard, so they fired daily false positives in the natural pre-cron / pre-post window
